subtitles.list: Each form or survey connects to a module, and each question goes to a field of that module.
subtitles.responses: Everything people answered, linked to the record it created or updated.

state.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage forms. It comes with the "Manage custom fields" permission.
state.notConfigured: Responses can't be read on this server yet: the module's encryption key is missing.

moduleHint.leads: Public link for your website: each response creates a lead.
moduleHint.clients: Personal link by email: Northstack already knows which contact is answering.
moduleHint.employees: Personal link by email: the response goes to the employee file.
moduleHint.support: Public link: each response creates a ticket. Enabled with the Clients module.
moduleHint.projects: Each response creates a task in the project you choose.

action.add_contact: Adds a contact to their company
action.save_to_file: Saves the response to the employee file

lands.create_lead: In Contacts, as a new lead{{pipeline}}. If the email already exists, it's linked without overwriting anything.
lands.update_contact: On the responding contact's record: only the fields you chose below.
lands.add_contact: As a new contact in the responder's company.
lands.update_employee: In the responder's employee file: only the fields you chose below.
lands.save_to_file: In the responder's employee file, as a saved response.
lands.create_ticket: As a support ticket (enabled with the Clients module).
lands.create_task: As a task in the chosen project, assigned to whoever you pick.
lands.survey: In Responses and on the responder's record. The score feeds the surveys dashboard.
lands.surveyAnonymous: In Responses, without the responder's name. Department results only show with 3 or more responses.

list.infoModuleTitle: Each one connects to a module
list.infoModuleBody: Leads, Clients, Employees, Support or Projects. That way every response knows where it goes and which record it lands on.
list.infoMapTitle: Each question goes to a field
list.infoMapBody: You choose which module field each answer goes to, including the company's custom fields.
list.infoLinkBody: Leads and Support use a public link for your website. Clients and Employees get a personal link, so Northstack already knows who's answering.

editor.name: Name
editor.health: Responses count toward the client's health score
editor.anonymous: Anonymous (department results only, with 3 or more responses)
editor.created: Created. You can keep editing it.
editor.deleteBody: The form is deleted. This is only possible because nobody has answered it yet.
editor.legacyNotice: This form was built with the previous editor and keeps working at its usual link. To move it to this editor, build the questions and save: from then on it works with the module and action you choose.
editor.shareTitle: Link and code for your website
editor.personalBody: Each person gets a personal link by email, with Northstack's template. That's why there's no need to ask who they are.
editor.previewAsPublic: What visitors to the link see
editor.previewAsPersonal: What the person with the personal link sees
editor.publishToShare: Publish it to get the public URL and the code for your website. While it's a draft, the link doesn't answer.
editor.publicUrlHint: Share it on WhatsApp, email or social media, or put it behind a button on your website.
editor.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select it and copy it by hand.
editor.embedStyle: How it looks on your website
editor.domains: Domains where it can be embedded
editor.domainsHint: Empty = any website. With domains, nobody can put your form on another site.
editor.afterRedirect: Go to a page on my website
editor.publicSafety: Shows the company logo (Settings › Company profile). Spam protection, a per-IP submission limit and encrypted responses. Campaigns with UTM become the lead's source.

error.invalid_action: That action doesn't belong to this module.
error.select_needs_options: Choice questions need at least 2 options.
error.target_mapped_twice: Two questions go to the same field.
error.invalid_target: A question goes to a field that doesn't exist in this module.
error.target_type_mismatch: A question's type doesn't fit the chosen field (for example, an email has to come from an Email question).
error.survey_needs_rating: A survey needs a scale question (0-10 or 1-5).
error.task_needs_project: Choose the project where tasks are created.
error.task_needs_assignee: Choose who tasks are assigned to.
error.has_responses: It has responses: move it to draft instead of deleting it.
error.legacy_form: Build the questions with the new editor before saving.

requiredTargets.create_lead: Contact · Email and Contact · First name
requiredTargets.add_contact: Contact · Email and Contact · First name

responses.hint: Click a response to see every question and answer.

modal.notLinked: It isn't linked to any record.
modal.anonymousLinked: Anonymous response: who answered isn't stored.

starterText.nps: How likely are you to recommend us to a colleague?
starterText.enps: How likely are you to recommend working here to a friend?
starterText.subject: Subject
starterText.question: Question

embedHint.inline: The form appears where you paste the code and adjusts its height on its own.
embedHint.button: A fixed button at the bottom right opens the form in a window.
embedHint.popup: A button where you paste the code opens the form in a window.

send.publishFirst: Publish it to be able to send it.
send.recent: sent on {{date}}, can be resent after 60 days
send.rule: A person gets the same form or survey at most once every 60 days. The link expires after 30 days and can be answered once.
send.sentWithSkipped: Sent to {{count}}. {{skipped}} weren't sent because they got it less than 60 days ago.
send.autoBody: Northstack sends it every day to whoever it applies to. You can also send it by hand.
send.autoLater: This trigger turns on with the Clients module. Meanwhile, send it by hand.

dash.empty: No responses in this period. Publish a form or send a survey to get started.
dash.thresholdNote: For anonymity, a department shows its eNPS only with {{min}} or more responses.
dash.departmentsHidden: No department shows its eNPS: those with fewer than {{min}} responses could be worked out from the total.
